description: QUASAR aims to develop retina-safe SWIR detectors with high detectivity and fast modulation response, enabling applications in advanced LiDAR systems and other high-performance sensing platforms.
funding_summary: Funded by the European Research Council (ERC) under the Horizon Europe program.
inflection_why_now: Recent breakthroughs in solution-processed materials and large-area superlattice assembly present a timely opportunity to advance SWIR photodetector technology.
devils_advocate_risks: Technical Risk: Challenges in achieving the desired performance metrics for the photodetectors.
Market Risk: Uncertainty regarding the adoption of new photodetector technologies in existing applications.

lp_synergy_matches.reason: Evonik specializes in advanced materials and chemicals, which could complement QUASAR's work in developing novel photodetectors.
Boehringer Ingelheim's interest in innovative technologies could align with QUASAR's advancements in optoelectronics for medical imaging applications.
